shadow.reason: Figma puts shadow/dialog on the popover's frame, which has no fill, and so draws only its first shadow, cast by the bubble and tip together, and not its 2px ring (Figma draws no spread on an unfilled frame). No box shadow draws either: one on the frame would shade the empty strip beside the tip, and SOLAR has no drop-shadow token. The bubble carries the shadow instead (content.base.shadow); the design review asks.

gap.reason: Same value, governed token: a gap Figma leaves unbound at 0 is the none of its family, and SOLAR picks the family by direction, as its own bound gaps do: a horizontal auto layout's gap is an inset, a vertical one's a stack (the Foundations agent reference and the Spatial chapter). Decided once here, as the paddings are.

docs.description: Anchored overlay with an arrow for rich content — a title, body text and optionally controls — opened from a trigger. 8 variants: placement (top, bottom, left, right) × size (sm, md). title and body are text props. Uses shadow/overlay at the overlay z level; dismisses on Esc or outside click; focus moves into it only when it contains controls. For a one-line hint use Tooltip; for a list of actions use Dropdown.

rules.reason: An anchored overlay for rich content, as the description says: a title, its words and the caller's controls, in a bubble whose tip points at its trigger from the side `placement` names, dismissed by Escape or a click outside it, the focus moving into it only where it holds controls. MUI's Popover on the web, its paper the drawn surface; in Flutter drawn in an overlay over its trigger. Without an anchor it is the surface alone, drawn in place, as the visual checks draw it.
